answer.reason: The proposed correction to B (469,073) is not plausible for NAICS 23 Construction in Virginia. Virginia's total private covered employment in late 2024 was roughly 3.4-3.5 million jobs, and construction typically accounts for only about 6-7% of private employment in the state (consistent with BLS CES/QCEW figures showing Virginia construction employment in the low-to-mid 200,000s, dipping seasonally in December). A figure of 469,073 would imply construction is ~13-14% of Virginia private jobs, which is far outside any known range; a number in that range is more characteristic of a different industry row (e.g., health care and social assistance). The December (month-3) QCEW private construction level of 220,976 fits the known magnitude for Virginia NAICS 23, so the draft answer A should stand and the user's proposed correction to B should be rejected.
